items.label: colloquial topic particle
items.explanation: って is the spoken form of は/というのは; it introduces 辛いもの as the theme: 'spicy food, (as for it)...'.

items.jp: チーズは牛乳からできるって、知らないの？

translation.pt-BR: Você não sabe que o queijo é feito de leite?
translation.en: Don't you know cheese is made from milk?

items.label: quotative particle って (= と; quotes the statement)
items.explanation: って (colloquial version of と) packages 'cheese is made from milk' as the content being mentioned before 'don't you know?'.

items.jp: 今朝寝坊して学校に遅れた

translation.pt-BR: Hoje de manhã dormi demais e me atrasei para a escola.
translation.en: This morning I overslept and was late for school.

items.label: connective particle (て-form) with sequential/causal sense
items.explanation: て chains 寝坊する with the following clause: 'I overslept AND (therefore) I was late'. It links two actions in sequence, suggesting cause.
tokens: nominal root of the compound verb 寝坊する

items.jp: しばらく連絡してなくてごめんね。

translation.pt-BR: Desculpa por não ter dado notícias por um tempo.
translation.en: Sorry for not contacting you recently.

items.label: connective particle (〜て form of cause/linking)
items.explanation: て closes なくて, linking the negated clause ('not having sent word') to the reason for the apology, a use of 〜て with a causal nuance ('for not...').

items.jp: やかんでお湯を沸かしている

translation.pt-BR: Estou esquentando água na chaleira.
translation.en: I'm heating water in the kettle.

items.label: instrument/means particle
items.explanation: で here indicates the instrument with which the action is done: the water is heated using the kettle.

items.jp: どこで乗り換えればいいですか

translation.pt-BR: Onde eu devo fazer a baldeação?
translation.en: Where should I make the transfer?

items.label: particle of place of action (で)
items.explanation: Marks どこ (where) as the place at which the action of transferring would happen.

items.jp: このお祭りは県下で有名です

translation.pt-BR: Esta festa é famosa no estado todo.
translation.en: This festival is famous throughout the state.

items.label: delimits the scope where the quality holds
items.explanation: で indicates the area within which the festival is famous: 'throughout the province'. It is the で of scope/place, not the で of means.
tokens: suffix forming 県下 ('within the prefecture')

items.jp: 各駅で電車が止まる

translation.pt-BR: O trem para em cada estação.
translation.en: The train stops at every station.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates the place where the action happens; 各駅で = 'at each station', where the train makes its stop.

items.jp: 手をアルコールで消毒する

translation.pt-BR: Desinfetar as mãos com álcool.
translation.en: Disinfect your hands with alcohol.

items.label: means/instrument marker
items.explanation: で indicates the material used to perform the action: one disinfects 'with alcohol'.
tokens: verbal noun (head of the compound verb)
